title: AlarmStatusChange
description: Carried on alarms.status.changed; generic alarm lifecycle status change, fired by any service, consumed by Alarm Manager.

alarmId.description: The alarm whose status changed; matches AlarmEvent.alarmId.

newStatus.description: New lifecycle status: open; in-progress (alarm entered an active correlation instance); correlated (a completed match); cleared; reverted-open (instance expired without a match).

source.description: The service that fired the change (e.g. correlation-engine, enrichment, alarm-manager); names the originator of the status change.

changedAt.description: When the status change occurred (ISO-8601 UTC).
